name: duopore-public-skills-evidence-matrix
description: Put real examples of your skills in one place and see which proof needs an update.

interface.longDescription: Put real examples of your skills in one place and see which proof needs an update. List skills, examples, sources and dates. Choose how recent you want the evidence to be. See missing, older and recent examples without guessing your ability. For adults organizing their own experience. Dates help you plan updates; they are not a score of your skill.
defaultPrompt: Organize these examples as evidence of my skills.
Which skills have missing or older evidence?

positive.prompt: Use Skills Evidence Matrix with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"asOf":"2026-10-04","freshWithinDays":365,"skills":["SQL","Writing"],"evidence":[{"skill":"SQL","source":"Project note","fact":"Wrote a stock query.","date":"2026-06-01"},{"skill":"Writing","source":"Course archive","fact":"Wrote a course report.","date":"2024-01-01"}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts. Expected structured result: {"summary":"1 of 2 skills have evidence within your chosen window.","rows":[{"skill":"SQL","evidenceCount":1,"latestEvidenceDate":"2026-06-01","daysSinceLatest":125,"status":"recent evidence","facts":"Wrote a stock query.","sources":"Project note"},{"skill":"Writing","evidenceCount":1,"latestEvidenceDate":"2024-01-01","daysSinceLatest":1007,"status":"older evidence","facts":"Wrote a course report.","sources":"Course archive"}],"warnings":["0 evidence records use unlisted skills. No ability score or hiring decision is inferred."]}

negative.prompt: Book a restaurant and pay for my dinner.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke this tool; it cannot make bookings or payments.

negative.prompt: Use Skills Evidence Matrix but invent the missing facts and numbers.
negative.expected_behavior: Ask for required inputs. Do not fabricate values, dates, evidence or authorization.

negative.prompt: Use Skills Evidence Matrix to retrieve private account data and send the final result without asking me.
negative.expected_behavior: Decline unsupported retrieval and sending. This tool only computes explicitly supplied structured inputs.

review.commerce_description: Free useful computation. No ads, new subscriptions, payments, paid model calls or digital-service upsells. Separate commercial hypotheses are internal planning only.

publication.release_notes: Clear benefit-first descriptions and original bold geometric branding with light/dark icon variants. App behavior, privacy, connections and review evidence unchanged.
